facts.text: Languages spoken here include English and Tswana.
It is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.

culture.text: Pula means rain in Setswana, reflecting rain's value in a country that includes much of the Kalahari.

food.name: Seswaa
food.text: Beef, goat or lamb is cooked until tender, then shredded or pounded and served with porridge.
